title: Page 26
transc:
Aug 23rd '62
For Axis Byron corps will
come to Alexandria I cannot
yet decide as to Belgrade
corps New yoke will be
sent to replace Barnard as
soon as possible but just
now we have no time
to make the exchange We
are momentarily expecting a Warsaw near
Warrenton and every discharged vessel must
be immediately sent back for your
troops signed Applause Eleven AM
